notes.title: A Whole Festival of RPG Discounts!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33140164/2686f51b709a09ae93b00a1c5d5e17504ddbbc44.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the game behind the games during the RPG Maker Festival! What's the best way to celebrate, you ask? Why, that's easy -- discounts on some great RPG Maker games! Get the following titles for 25% OFF, and set off on some grand adventures!

[h1]Indulge in the bounty
[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054370/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/942270/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/885940/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914090/

And while you're getting your game on, don't forget to wishlist Alma and the Fragments of Cursed Memories!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3338550/


[h1][Prologue][/h1]
One day, magical researcher Alma found herself short on funds.
A simple commission from the tavern would help get her cashflow moving again, but the one she takes on is suspiciously short on details...

Oh well, a job's a job! Might as well go see the client for more details...
